aiHairTryOnConsentIntro: To generate hairstyle previews, your photo (which may include your face) will be securely sent to our third-party AI partner, Replicate, Inc., for processing only.
aiHairTryOnConsentBulletPhoto: • Data shared: your uploaded photo and optional text prompt.
aiHairTryOnConsentBulletPrompt: • Facial attributes (face shape, skin tone, approximate age) may be analyzed only to recommend hairstyles.
aiHairTryOnConsentBulletVendor: • Processed by Replicate, Inc. (United States). We do not store face-recognition templates or use your images for AI training.
aiHairTryOnConsentBulletRetention: • Uploaded images are deleted from processing servers within 24 hours.
aiHairTryOnConsentBulletOptional: • This feature is optional. You can decline and continue using the rest of the app.
aiChatConsentIntro: To answer your questions, the text you type in AI Chat will be sent to FreshPass's secure AI service for processing.
aiChatConsentBulletData: • Data shared: your chat messages, session ID, and optional business context you select.
aiChatConsentBulletRecipient: • Sent to FreshPass's AI service (hosted on our servers) to generate replies. We do not sell your chats or use them to train public AI models.
aiChatConsentBulletRetention: • Chat history is stored on our servers while your account is active so you can continue conversations. You can clear chat anytime in the app.
aiChatConsentBulletOptional: • This feature is optional. Tap Not Now to decline and continue using the rest of the app.
aiVoiceConsentIntro: To power voice conversations, your microphone audio will be sent in real time to FreshPass's AI voice service.
aiVoiceConsentBulletData: • Data shared: live voice audio from your microphone during the call, plus your account session token to authenticate the session.
aiVoiceConsentBulletRecipient: • Sent to FreshPass's AI voice service (secure WebSocket) to transcribe your speech and generate spoken responses.
aiVoiceConsentBulletRetention: • Voice audio is processed in real time and is not stored as a permanent recording on our servers after the session ends.
aiVoiceConsentBulletOptional: • This feature is optional. Tap Not Now to decline and continue using the rest of the app.
